name: Contact Form Indexing
description: Adds a robots meta tag to contact forms to control search-engine indexing.
project_description:
This module allows to add metatag robots if not present , and will add indexation-controlling parameters index,follow to specific contact forms.

 This will tell the search engines to index and will let the crawlers to follow the links on selective forms only.

 Requirements: 

 No special requirements

 Installation: 

 * Extract and enable this module.

* After enabling the module, each contact form will show a checkbox "Enable Form Indexing".

* Select this checkbox to add indexing parameters index,follow on this form.
